articles.title: Maharashtra Introduces Performance Rating System For Contractors Handling ₹500-Crore-Plus Infrastructure Projects
articles.description: Maharashtra has introduced a Contractor Performance Assessment and Rating (PAR) Framework for all upcoming infrastructure tenders worth ₹500 crore or more. Contractors will be rated on timely completion, quality and maintenance performance, with poor-performing firms facing disqualification and additional safeguards being imposed on lower-rated bidders.

articles.title: Delhi’s GeM procurement jumps 156% to Rs 1,595 crore in FY27 till July
articles.description: Purchases through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) in Delhi rose 156 per cent year-on-year to Rs 1,595 crore during the first four months of FY 2026-27, according to official data, reflecting increased use of the Centre's online public procurement platform.

articles.title: Delhi government's purchases from GeM portal jump 156% to Rs 1,595 cr in April-July
articles.description: Delhi government's purchases via GeM portal surged 156 percent to Rs 1,595 crore. This significant increase provides a strong platform for micro and small enterprises. Government procurement through GeM reached Rs 4,311 crore in 2025-26. The participation of women and SC/ST entrepreneurs is also increasing. Delhi has been recognized for sustained services procurement adoption on the platform.
